LESSON: READING 8.2.2 COMPREHENSION

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade two
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 8
Topic 8.2: Reading 8.2.2 Comprehension
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 8.2.2 Comprehension, part of Strand 8 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade two General.

Key inquiry question: How can we predict how a story, poem or conversation will end? 2. How can we tell where events have taken place?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 8.2.2 Comprehension together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication: The learner’s ability to speak engagingly is enhanced as they retell stories.

• Creativity and imagination: The learner’s ability to make connections is enhanced as they talk about their own experiences in relation to

the story.

Values:
Responsibility: is enhanced as learner takes up assigned roles up assigned during group activities with peers.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Life skill (Self-esteem): The learner’s self-esteem is nurtured as they answer questions correctly.
